title: Matrix conversation adapter
lead: A Matrix bot account that receives commands and sends replies and notifications.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** end-to-end encrypted rooms, unless the interview requires them.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Chat suits quick back-and-forth better than email, and Matrix is FLOSS and self-hostable.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: Approve the Matrix client library chosen in the notifications interview (NF6).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Sync loop on the bot account; map Matrix IDs to people.
2. Replies and notifier pings to each person's room.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; the owner and one household member exchange commands with larder in Matrix.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
